Questions families ask

Faith Academy FAQ

Is this a regular devotional app?

No. Elevate Faith Academy is an online course for kids. Children learn a Bible truth, then practice it through prayer, reflection, family conversation and a quiz.

Why does some content stay the same all week?

The week's video, devotional and NIV memory verse form one practice focus. Day 1 shows them open. On Days 2 to 7 they start collapsed so Prayer Time is the first open activity, but the video and devotional are still required before the next day unlocks.

What changes each day?

Each day has its own prayer timer, reflection notes, Ask Parents prompt and quiz. Everyone starts at Week 1, and the next week unlocks only when the previous week is fully complete. You can do one day each calendar day, so the next day opens on the next calendar day.

How many Coins can a child earn?

Kids can earn up to 478 coins a week as they move through the course. Coins stay pending until a parent approves them in Parent’s Corner.

Why are Coins pending?

Activity Coins wait in Parent's Corner so a parent can approve the work or dismiss it for another attempt.

One bonus is still available

Are you sure you want to mark the day complete?

You still have unclaimed bonus coins you can ask your parents to claim.

Family guide

How to Use Elevate Faith Academy

Elevate Faith Academy is an online course for kids. It helps kids build practical faith skills through fun, consistent daily practice.

Points ⭐

Only the daily quiz earns Points. You can take up to 5 quizzes a day, all free, and the Points from every quiz add up, up to 45 Points a day. Spend them on stickers and pets. Once an Epic or Legendary sticker is in your collection, future quiz Points get a 15% bonus.

Coins 🪙

Kids can earn up to 478 coins a week as they move through the course. Coins stay pending until a parent approves them.

Rapid Rewards

Spend Points on stickers and pets, starting at 7 Points. Redeemed rewards stay in your collection.

Parent Rewards

Parents, set small and large prizes so kids have something to look forward to as they earn coins through the course.

Parent gift planning

Set reachable gift prices

Kids can earn up to 478 coins a week as they move through the course.

All Coins stay pending until you approve them in Parent's Corner. Try 50 to 150 Coins for small, reachable gifts. Set bigger dream gifts higher so children can save toward them over time.

Terms & Conditions

  • A parent or legal guardian creates and manages every child profile.
  • By creating an account, you agree to receive account-related emails, such as your child's progress updates and reminders about rewards waiting for your approval. These emails are part of the service.
  • Only the daily quiz earns Points. Each correct answer earns 3 Points, up to 9 Points per quiz. Kids can take up to 5 quizzes a day, all free, and the Points from every quiz add up, up to 45 Points a day.
  • Daily activities earn Coins that stay pending until a parent approves them. Kids can earn up to 478 Coins a week as they move through the course. Parents cannot add Coins manually.
  • Parents are responsible for reviewing activities and submitted workbook responses.
  • What we collect: the parent's name and account details, each child's first name or nickname and avatar choice, completed activities, Points and Coins earned, and stickers or pets unlocked. At signup we note the country from the internet connection, then discard the technical details.
  • What the administrator sees: only combined, anonymous statistics such as number of families, countries, and most popular stickers. The administrator never sees children's names, contact details, exact location, or the words children write in reflections and workbooks. Those stay private to your family.
  • Parents may ask for a copy of their family's data or ask us to delete it at any time by contacting us at info@elevate-w-ai.org.
  • We keep family data only as long as the account is active and as required by law.
  • The app is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent allowed by law.
  • To the fullest extent allowed by law, Elevate Faith Academy, its owner and operators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.
  • You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Elevate Faith Academy, its owner and operators, from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the app or your violation of these terms.
  • If any part of these terms is found unenforceable, the remaining parts stay in full effect.
